verification: The app's XDG_DATA_HOME pointed to an isolated temporary profile with the exact isolation marker. Other environment values were discarded; no command arguments were read.

processes.verifiedRole: Node helper; exact script was not inspected

finding: The original comm-only rule places unrecognized descendants in app. MainThread therefore counted a proven Node helper's CPU and RSS as app resources.

consequences.combinedPeakRule: Sum all component values at each original sample timestamp, then take the maximum; do not sum separate component maxima.

limitations: This is one instantaneous observation, not a per-process history or a phase-linked peak measurement.
Executable basename establishes Node identity, not which script or job it ran. It does not prove a frozen extractor was the unidentified process.
CPU tick counts are cumulative process counters at the snapshot, not interval CPU percentages.
The original six-arm report is retained unchanged. No classifier fix or rerun was performed while archiving it.
